RIFAMPICIN.explanation:
ERR040120 is predicted Resistant to RIFAMPICIN (probability of resistance 1.0000).

The largest SHAP contribution is pos_761155 in rpoB (C>T, SHAP +0.2805), which pushes the prediction toward resistance. In the WHO mutation catalogue this allele is rpoB p.Ser450Leu (rpoB_p.Ser450Leu), a missense variant. The final confidence grading for Rifampicin is 1) Assoc w R (associated with resistance). Catalogue figures: PPV 0.980, solo counts 8722 resistant and 190 susceptible.

pos_4247730 in embB (G>A, SHAP +0.0640), which pushes the prediction toward resistance. The allele matches WHO catalogue variant embB_p.Gly406Asp, which has no grading row for Rifampicin. The catalogue grades this allele as associated with resistance for Ethambutol (embB p.Gly406Asp, 1) Assoc w R).

pos_761110 in rpoB (reference allele, SHAP -0.0312), which pushes the prediction toward susceptibility. This coordinate is the site of WHO alleles graded associated with Rifampicin resistance (rpoB p.Asp435Val, rpoB p.Asp435Gly, rpoB p.Asp435Ala). The isolate carries the reference base.

pos_761139 in rpoB (reference allele, SHAP -0.0130), which pushes the prediction toward susceptibility. This coordinate is the site of WHO alleles graded associated with Rifampicin resistance (rpoB p.His445Tyr, rpoB p.His445Asn, rpoB p.His445Asp). The isolate carries the reference base.

That is the only WHO group 1 or 2 Rifampicin allele in this isolate.

SHAP values are the contributions of each feature to this model's resistant-class score for the isolate. WHO grades come from the second-edition mutation catalogue (WHO/UCN/TB/2023.7): an exact match on NC_000962.3 position, reference nucleotide, and alternate nucleotide, then the final confidence grading for the drug.
RIFAMPICIN.who_catalogue_source: WHO catalogue of mutations in Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, second edition (WHO/UCN/TB/2023.7)
